'''''Echium boissieri''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the borage family [[Boraginaceae]]. It is native to the western [[Mediterranean Basin]] in the [[Iberian Peninsula]] and [[Northwest Africa]]. It is single-stemmed and can reach up to {{convert|2.5|m|abbr=on}} in height.<ref>{{cite web |title=E. boissieri |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/11_138_16_Echium.pdf |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=26 September 2021 |page=442}}</ref>
